fields.description: Ocean Point combines one- to three-bedroom apartments with eight three-bedroom townhouses at Rashid Yachts & Marina. Two apartment buildings frame shared landscaped spaces, while townhouse layouts include large terraces and separate upstairs bedrooms. The setting connects residential gardens with the wider marina neighbourhood.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

overview: Ocean Point’s shared spaces are arranged around gardens, pool areas and places to exercise or play. The brochure connects this residential setting to Rashid Yachts & Marina’s promenade and canal-pool district. Retail, dining and wider marina attractions belong to the surrounding master community; their operation and access terms should be confirmed separately.
research.locationNote: Ocean Point is at Rashid Yachts & Marina in Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar identifies the QE2 Hotel and routes towards Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. The brochure’s skyline and landscaped outlooks are orientation-dependent, not a guarantee for every apartment.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.66m. The launch fact sheet lists one-bedroom apartments from AED 1.66m, two-bedroom from AED 2.4m, three-bedroom from AED 3.33m and townhouses from AED 5.79m. These are historic starting prices; available stock and current quotations require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The published launch schedule has ten 10% payments: booking, eight further instalments, and the final 10% at estimated completion. Property Finder’s Ocean Point 1 entry corroborates 10/80/10. The dates below are launch terms, not a payment instruction for a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: The launch document estimates June 2028 completion; Property Finder’s Ocean Point 1 listing also reports Q2 2028. Confirm the building-specific contractual date and current progress.

facts.label: Published unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 97 one-bedroom, 86 two-bedroom and 26 three-bedroom apartments, plus eight townhouses: 217 homes in total. This does not describe remaining inventory.

facts.label: Townhouse TH-1A
facts.value: All three bedrooms are upstairs. Below are kitchen/dining and living rooms, a maid’s room and bathroom, laundry, powder room, storage and a large terrace.

facts.label: Outdoor area matters
facts.value: TH02’s 3,040.27 sq ft total consists of 2,190.89 sq ft suite and 849.38 sq ft terrace. The published total is not an indoor-only or plot measurement.

facts.label: Count requires reconciliation
facts.value: The launch sheet totals 217 homes, but an online reproduction of Emaar’s FY2025 investor table assigns 154 units to Ocean Point. Confirm the current approved project count.
